brief: Counts things in a text: a fragment, overlapping fragments, regex matches, graphemes, marks and the characters of one script.
detail: It is the counting helper of stzString, which builds one over itself for its Count family; build one with new stzStringCounter("text") when you only need to count. Every count is by characters, so Hebrew, Arabic and emoji text counts as you expect, and every method answers a number and leaves the text alone. The script counts (CountHebrew, CountCyrillic, CountCjk, CountDevanagari, CountThai) and CountMarks, CountControls and GraphemeCount look at the whole text. Found today: CountBetween and CountBetweenCS raise R3 because they call a function that does not exist; CountOverlappingCS ignores its case flag; NumberOfCharsCS with 0 counts distinct letters; CountLeadingChar and CountTrailingChar stop the Ring process on an empty text; and a counter built from a stzString object reads an empty text once that string is appended to or replaced.
